segments.comment: Independent apply.c use_whip() case for its whipattack path against a monster that wields nothing while the hero's proficiency is 0. The debug-mode Priest rolls Dx 12 at this seed, so proficient stays 0 and force_attack() is skipped. She wishes for an uncursed bullwhip (letter i), wields it, and applies it south-east at the lichen that starts beside her: C prints "You flick your bullwhip towards the lichen." and then use_whip()'s msg_snap, "Snap!".
